subject: Stage status matrix and exec pack gap list
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Stage status matrix and exec pack gap list

Team —

We need to lock the QBR leadership pack by EOD today. To get there I need two things from each AM/manager by close of business:

1) Updated row in the attached stage_status_template.csv for every open Opportunity you own (Status column + expected close and commit confidence).
2) A short note on any slides you want included in the exec pack (one PDF or a 1-slide PDF). If you have market/customer context that affects commit, add it in the Notes column.

Please follow these quick rules so the pack is consistent:
- Commit = signed contract (or PO) OR documented legal/finance approval + sales intake note.
- Stage names must be normalized to: Prospect, Opportunity, Commit, Closed-Won, Closed-Lost.
- Use the Confidence column: High / Medium / Low.

Attachments: stage_status_template.csv, exec_pack_toc.md (TOC for slides).
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2B_stage-matrix

I'll compile and send a leadership-ready pack by 5pm. If you absolutely can't meet EOD, flag here and include what you can.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Americas Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Stage status matrix and exec pack gap list

Quick clarification on Commit definition — I propose we treat Commit as: Legal sign OR PO received OR Sales leader email approval referencing deal id + finance confirmation. We should avoid counting verbal commitments unless there's an email trail.

I've uploaded my updated rows (stage_status_updated.csv) and added HubSpot links for the top 6 deals so reviewers can validate numbers quickly: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/RED-12345

Notes on two tricky ones:
- Greenfield Partners: Forecasted close this quarter but CS requires a technical POC before we can finalize pricing.
- ACME Health (DEAL-9876): Marissa's note is accurate — PO expected; legal routing in progress.

Attachment: stage_status_updated.csv

— Karthik
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-12T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stage status matrix and exec pack gap list

Thanks — I pulled the uploaded CSV. Two requests before I can finalize the slides:

1) A couple of entries are missing ARR and ACV columns (Greenfield Partners, BlueSky Labs). Please paste the ARR as a numeric value in the ARR column.
2) For any deal listed as Commit, please confirm whether discount/credits are baked into the committed amount or managed separately. We need this to compute the net ARR for the exec slide.

If you want, I can estimate based on current pricing but would prefer the AM numbers. Target to me by 3pm and I'll fold into the executive deck.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of FP&A (acting)

Subject: Final: Exec pack assembly and immediate next steps

Thanks for the quick turn. Final checklist before I assemble the pack for leadership: 

- Laura: incorporate ARR numbers for Greenfield / BlueSky by 4:30pm (noted)
- Marissa: push for the PO with Emily; if PO doesn't arrive by EOD tomorrow, we'll mark ACME as "Commit (pending PO)" and include the DocuSign link in the appendix.
- Karthik: ensure HubSpot links are included for each Commit deal (use the Deal ID column).
- All: normalize Stage names and Confidence column — I will validate and call out any rows that don't conform.

I'll produce a single PDF (leadership_pack_Q3_pipeline.pdf) and share the Drive folder for review at 5:00pm. If anyone has a problem meeting any of the items above, reply with a clear blocker.

Deliverables I will publish at 17:00: compiled slide deck + exported stage CSV + one-line executive summary.

— Sergio
Director, Americas Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
